About the Company.

namuna_02 is a trading company engaged in wholesale and retail sales. It operates its own network of retail stores and service centers, a logistics center, and the EXZAP.UZ marketplace.

The company’s structure includes a wholesale department with regional managers, a retail department with sales teams, its own retail network, and branches across the Republic of Uzbekistan. The company employs more than 300 people.

namuna_02 leads the Uzbek market in terms of product assortment.
